# Where to Watch Beyond Belief


by Angel | October 16, 2026


Big hair, electric guitars, and the unmistakable sound of ’80s rock. *Beyond Belief* takes audiences back to a time when music could shape a dream—and sometimes, a mysterious voice could change everything.


Featuring the iconic music of Petra, *Beyond Belief* blends humor, nostalgia, and an uplifting story about learning to trust God’s plan.


[Stream Beyond Belief today on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/beyond-belief)


### **A Teenage Rocker With Big Dreams**


Andy has his sights set on a future in music. Like many young musicians, he’s chasing a dream and trying to figure out where he belongs. But the loss of his father adds another layer to his journey, leaving him to navigate grief alongside the pressures of growing up.


Just as Andy thinks he knows where life is headed, an unexpected voice sends him in a different direction. What follows challenges the future he imagined and asks him to consider whether there might be something bigger waiting for him.


### **A Trip Back to the ’80s Rock Scene**


For fans of ’80s rock, *Beyond Belief* brings back the sound and spirit of a memorable era. The film features music from Petra, the influential Christian rock band whose songs became a defining part of the decade for many listeners.


With Petra’s music woven into the story, the film offers a nostalgic trip for longtime fans and a chance for a new generation to discover the band’s sound. The involvement of the band’s actual members adds another layer of authenticity to the experience.


### **Watch** ***Beyond Belief*** **on Angel**


Ready to turn up the volume and take a trip back to the ’80s? Follow Andy’s unexpected journey as he discovers that God’s plans can reach far beyond the dreams he had for himself.


[Stream Beyond Belief now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/beyond-belief)
